description: Check pairwise drug-drug interactions for any 2-10 medications. Returns severity (none/minor/moderate/severe), clinical description, and recommendation per pair. Side feature of Symptia (https://symptia.app — Alya's Bayesian diagnosis platform, 'WebMD with a brain'). Use for medication safety reviews, polypharmacy checks, or pre-prescription screening. NOT a substitute for licensed medical advice. Premium ($0.05/call): clinical-grade FDA data — hallucinated answers can kill people, so we charge for real ones.
name: alya_drug_interactions
